subject: RetailCo governance onboarding & stakeholder checklist
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Simon Grant <simon.grant@retailco.com>, Emma Lee <emma.lee@retailco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RetailCo governance onboarding & stakeholder checklist

Hi Simon / Emma —

Thanks again for the productive discovery this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment across governance, procurement, and the executive sponsor: 

Summary of call
- Primary use case: customer service augmentation for US retail stores (high concurrency, strict PII handling).
- Decision criteria called out by Emma: SOC 2 evidence, encryption/KMS, data residency (US), and predictable latency under load.
- Economic buyer: Simon confirmed VP of Ops will sign off; expect exec review w/in 2–3 weeks.

Immediate asks (for procurement / security track)
1) Simon: please share the procurement contact and preferred commercial template (we can accept PO or DocuSign).
2) Emma / Alan (CISO): list of required security artifacts (SOC 2 report, pen test, data retention policy) — I noted you asked for an example SOC 2 summary and a network diagram sample.
3) RetailCo: please confirm target go-live window so we can size dedicated capacity and provide a cost estimate.

What we'll provide by Monday
- Draft SOW + mutual action plan (attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx)
- SOC 2 executive summary (attachment: SOC2-summary-2025.pdf)
- Example procurement terms we commonly accept (PDF stub in SOW)

Proposed governance cadence
- Steering committee readout (30–45 mins) to exec sponsor: high-level risks, timeline, cost envelope
- Security deep-dive (tech team + Alan) to validate controls and redlines
- Procurement handoff once SOW and pricing are agreed

Can we lock a tentative slot for a steering prep on Tue Oct 13 10:00–10:30 PT? If that works I’ll prepare a short one-pager for the exec sponsor and circulate meeting materials.

Thanks —
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
(attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx)

From: Simon Grant <simon.grant@retailco.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Emma Lee <emma.lee@retailco.com>
Cc: Alan Chen <alan.chen@retailco.com>, procurement@retailco.com
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RetailCo governance onboarding & stakeholder checklist

Hi Olga —

Great summary, thanks. A few notes: 
- I’ve looped in Alan (CISO) and our procurement alias. Alan will confirm the security artifact wishlist; procurement will confirm contractual route (PO vs DocuSign).
- Our economic buyer is Sarah Mills (VP of Operations). I’m scheduling a short intro with her next week — I’ll aim for Thu Oct 15.
- Target go-live window is early Q1 2027; we’re aiming for limited rollout in late Jan.

Procurement note: we generally prefer PO but can do DocuSign for pilot projects. Procurement will need a draft SOW and an estimate of committed vs burst capacity pricing.

Simon
Simon Grant
Head of Digital Operations, RetailCo

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Simon Grant <simon.grant@retailco.com>
Cc: Emma Lee <emma.lee@retailco.com>, Alan Chen <alan.chen@retailco.com>, procurement@retailco.com
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RetailCo governance onboarding & stakeholder checklist

Thanks Simon / team — quick technical ask from our side so security can triage efficiently: 
- Can Alan confirm which of the following are MUST vs Nice-to-have:
  * SOC 2 Type II full report vs SOC 2 summary
  * External pentest report within last 12 months
  * Network diagram (VPC peering / NAT / egress controls)
  * KMS/HSM requirement and key custody preferences

If any of these are MUST, we’ll prioritize assembling the artifacts and propose an architecture diagram that meets the constraint. I’ve attached a short SOC2 executive summary we typically share with exec sponsors.

Also — to help procurement estimate committed capacity: what average RPS and peak concurrency should we design for during pilot? RetailCo note on expected traffic will let us size a Dedicated pool vs hosted burst.

(attachment: SOC2-summary-2025.pdf)

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Simon Grant <simon.grant@retailco.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Alan Chen <alan.chen@retailco.com>, procurement@retailco.com
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RetailCo governance onboarding & stakeholder checklist

Hi all —

Following up with the artifact bundle I promised. Attachments: RetailCo_SOW_Draft.pdf (draft SOW with pricing ranges), SOC2-summary-2025.pdf (same as Marcus referenced), and a short onboarding checklist we use for Steering prep.

Quick notes on security items:
- SOC 2: we can provide a summary immediately; full Type II report requires an NDA for distribution in some cases — happy to route per your preference.
- Pentest: we have an external pentest from 2025; results available on request under an NDA.
- Network diagram: prepared a high-level diagram showing our VPC boundaries and egress controls — will include in the Steering packet.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) via standard KMS integrations; we also offer Redwood-managed keys if you prefer not to manage rotation.

Please confirm who will be the primary security reviewer and whether we should route sensitive artifacts via a secure link (I can create a protected Drive folder or NDA portal).

Next steps I’ll action:
- Finalize SOW for procurement (Naomi to update pricing bracket once Simon confirms target concurrency)
- Prepare 1-page exec sponsor brief for the Steering prep meeting
- Share secure artifact links once we have guidance on NDA preference

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
(attachment: RetailCo_SOW_Draft.pdf)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Simon Grant <simon.grant@retailco.com>, Emma Lee <emma.lee@retailco.com>, Alan Chen <alan.chen@retailco.com>, procurement@retailco.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 07:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RetailCo governance onboarding & stakeholder checklist

Simon / Emma —

Thanks for the quick turn. Based on availability Simon shared and internal schedules, proposing two options for the Steering prep (30 mins):
- Option A: Tue Oct 13, 10:00–10:30 PT (preferred)
- Option B: Wed Oct 14, 08:00–08:30 PT

Agenda (15 mins prep + 15 mins alignment):
1) 1-page exec sponsor brief (problem, benefits, high-level costs)
2) Security gating items and artifacts required before procurement (Naomi)
3) Procurement path and preferred commercial route (Simon / procurement)
4) Decision timeline and next milestones (owner assignments)

Please confirm your preferred slot and who will attend from RetailCo (specifically if Sarah Mills will join). I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the one-pager + SOW draft ahead of the meeting.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
